note: Real-seed finding on #1274 (wgs-restoration @ 1f2e6fdd): PAR's Kodlista_DIAGNOS declares no code system (B1 'Inget kodverk'), leaves Kod blank on every row and wraps a prose definition one line per row. No Socialstyrelsen workbook in the seed has a genuine labelled blank code, so the SOS reader keeps main's behaviour: a code row needs a code, a period row opens a section and the prose lines stay raw evidence. Expected values are read off the fixture under that rule.
